gold.taskDescription: The user wants to order a new pair of prescription sunglasses through an online retailer.

questions.title: Do you have a current, valid prescription on hand?
questions.description: Determine whether the user already has a prescription ready to submit, or needs to obtain one first.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for these sunglasses?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with to narrow down suitable retailers and frame options.

questions.title: Do you already have a preferred online retailer in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a specific site they want to use, such as Warby Parker, Zenni, or EyeBuyDirect.

questions.title: What lens type do you need for these sunglasses?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs single-vision, bifocal, progressive, or another lens type.

questions.title: Do you have a specific frame style or material preference?
questions.description: Understand aesthetic or practical preferences such as wraparound, aviator, acetate, or metal frames.

questions.title: Are there specific lens features you want included?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants add-ons like polarization, photochromic tint, anti-reflective coating, or UV protection.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which you need these to arrive?
questions.description: Establish whether there is a time constraint that affects retailer choice or shipping method selection.
